subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
title: Grade 12 English Language Arts: English 12
overview: Grade 12 English Language Arts immerses students in collegiate literary analysis, rhetorical critique of historical documents, research synthesis, and sophisticated composition.
competencies: Evaluate complex themes, character motivations, and literary craft in seminal literary works.
Analyze rhetorical devices, persuasive arguments, and philosophical premises in foundational texts.
Compose well-substantiated research papers and argumentative essays adhering to academic citations.
Engage in sophisticated scholarly seminar discourse, defending evidence-based conclusions.

modules.title: British & World Literature: Epic Foundations & Tragic Drama
modules.description: Analyzing seminal British and world literature from Beowulf and Chaucer to Shakespearean tragedy and Victorian satire.

topics.title: Anglo-Saxon Epics & Medieval Chivalry
topics.description: Analyzing heroism, fate (wyrd), and cultural transitions in Old and Middle English literature.

topics.title: Philosophical Dilemmas in Shakespearean Tragedy
topics.description: Analyzing existential dread, moral corruption, and dramatic soliloquies in Hamlet or Macbeth.

modules.title: Post-Colonial Voices, Modernist Irony & Dystopian Fiction
modules.description: Examining the breakdown of traditional narratives, post-colonial critiques of empire, and 20th-century dystopian warnings.

topics.title: Post-Colonial Literature and Subverting the Canon
topics.description: Analyzing how global authors reclaim agency and challenge imperial historical narratives.

topics.title: Dystopian Fiction, Propaganda and Surveillance
topics.description: Dissecting totalitarian language manipulation, doublethink, and authoritarian surveillance (e.g. 1984, Brave New World).

modules.title: Senior Capstone Inquiry & Collegiate Thesis Writing
modules.description: Conducting sustained collegiate inquiry, drafting an extensive multi-source thesis paper, and defending it before peers.

topics.title: Formulating Original Scholarship Theses
topics.description: Designing deep academic research questions exploring intersections of literature, ethics, and technology.

topics.title: Drafting and Defending the Capstone Paper
topics.description: Writing polished academic prose with formal scholarly citations and presenting formal oral defenses.
